clusters.name: Standard Customers
clusters.description: Customers with moderate income and average spending habits.
clusters.recommendation: Use loyalty programs and personalized offers to increase engagement.

clusters.name: Premium Customers
clusters.description: High-income customers with high spending activity.
clusters.recommendation: Offer premium products, exclusive deals, and VIP rewards.

clusters.name: High-Potential Customers
clusters.description: Lower-income customers who demonstrate high spending activity.
clusters.recommendation: Encourage loyalty with affordable bundles and targeted rewards.

clusters.name: Conservative Customers
clusters.description: High-income customers with relatively low spending activity.
clusters.recommendation: Use personalized recommendations and premium introductory offers.

clusters.name: Budget-Conscious Customers
clusters.description: Lower-income customers with relatively low spending activity.
clusters.recommendation: Promote discounts, value bundles, and affordable products.
